reason: £19.99 plus £4.99 delivery for one jar of gummies from a brand I have never heard of, with no reviews, is a lot to hand over. Gummies still feel like sweets to me, and I'd rather spend on a tablet I trust.
objection: I don't know this brand, there are no reviews, and I can't tell whether 180mg of magnesium in gummies is a serious dose or just a marketing claim on the jar.
would_change_my_mind: Free delivery on a single jar, plus a few reviews from women my age who have finished a jar and noticed a difference.
